note: Provisional reliability tiers proposed by the platform builder. Replace with an agreed definition (for example one adopted from DOSM or an employer) before publishing. A dataset takes the weakest tier among its listed source agencies.

tiers.1: Official statistics: produced by the national statistics office or the central bank under a published methodology.
tiers.2: Official administrative: produced by a ministry or government agency from its own operations.
tiers.3: Publisher is a company, an international body or an independent project (the data may still originate from an agency), or the agency is not recognised. Needs review.
